name: Kantor AI - Revenue Leakage & Finance Audit Sentry

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c.nomor_internet,
  c.nama_pelanggan,
  c.kode_bandwith,
  COALESCE(c.nama_kategori_bandwith, 'INTERNET') AS kategori,
  COALESCE(c.harga_bandwith, 0) AS harga_paket,
  b.kode_billing_layanan,
  COALESCE(b.total_layanan, 0) AS tagihan_terbit,
  CASE 
    WHEN b.kode_billing_layanan IS NULL THEN 'Missing Invoice (Aktif Tanpa Tagihan)'
    ELSE 'Tagihan Rp 0 Padahal Paket Berbayar'
  END AS indikasi_kebocoran
FROM view_batchjob c
LEFT JOIN trx_billing_layanan b ON c.nomor_internet = b.nomor_internet 
  AND b.bulan_tagihan = LPAD(MONTH(CURRENT_DATE()), 2, '0')
  AND b.tahun_tagihan = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())
  AND (b.hide IS NULL OR b.hide = '0')
WHERE c.status_reg = '20'
  AND (c.hide IS NULL OR c.hide = '0')
  AND (c.kode_bandwith NOT LIKE '%FREE%')
  AND (b.kode_billing_layanan IS NULL OR CAST(COALESCE(b.total_layanan, '0') AS DECIMAL(15,2)) <= 0)
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  b.kode_billing_layanan,
  b.nomor_internet,
  COALESCE(c.nama_pelanggan, 'Pelanggan') AS nama_pelanggan,
  CAST(b.total_layanan AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS nominal,
  b.date_update,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, b.date_update, NOW()) AS jam_menggantung
FROM trx_billing_layanan b
LEFT JOIN view_batchjob c ON b.nomor_internet = c.nomor_internet
WHERE b.status_bill_lay = '14'
  AND (b.hide IS NULL OR b.hide = '0')
  AND (b.date_update <= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR OR b.date_create <= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR)
LIMIT 10;
